evidence_uris: runtime /api/v1/simulation-runtime/scheduler/status 2026-07-14; CodeGraph nodes SimulationLifecycleScheduler, ProductionSimulationRunContextProvider, PreTradeTradabilityProvider, LocalSimExecutionBridge, LocalSimBackend, PaperTradingLiveMinuteExecutor
expected: Selection and planning are independent of current-day realtime quotes. A canonical Asia/Shanghai market-phase model distinguishes pre-open, auction, continuous trading, lunch, close auction, and post-close. Non-executable phases return explicit waiting outcomes without stale failures. Submit performs fresh side-aware validation for every plan intent, preserves no silent fallback, and delayed/restart LocalSIM consumes only bars after its durable causality cursor. LocalSIM batch execution and persistence remain consistent on partial failure, valid no-trade days are modeled explicitly, and wait diagnostics are cadence-deduplicated.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
title: LocalSIM lifecycle conflates non-trading phases with live quote freshness and permits non-causal retries
